title: IVG Pro Salts Hub Blast 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Hub Blast 10ml E-Liquid offers a wonderfully nostalgic and intensely fruity vaping experience. This lively recipe brings together a rich, juicy medley of Mixed Fruits to create a sweet and satisfying inhale. A distinct, chewy Bubblegum note then takes over on the exhale, providing a fun and comforting candy-inspired finish that lingers pleasantly on the palate. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the sweet nostalgia of Hub Blast, vapers can explore other standout options such as the zesty Lemon Fizz or the deeply refreshing Spearmint, ensuring a premium choice for every preference.
